_comment: S2.1 recall corpus. The 16 train queries are v1 recall-corpus.json at archive/v1-final, unchanged (semantic = natural-language questions, keyword = literal phrases from a target row; never filter prose). The 8 holdout queries are new in v2 and target rows the train set does not touch. Holdout is never used for tuning (L-M10). A query is a hit at k if ANY expectedTitles entry is in the top-k rows. Every query runs under each search mode.
